questionSnapshot.question: Which Disney animated film introduced the song 'A Whole New World' in 1992?

notes: Read all four options, relevant full topic digests and cross-bank comparisons. Category and editorial difficulty checked on final wording. Final challenge checks the exact named entity/event against each listed alternative, not merely a matching answer keyword.

verification.context: Which Disney animated film introduced the song 'A Whole New World' in 1992?

premise.reason: Aladdin introduced the song in its 1992 production.

sources.locator: 1992 release paragraph; songwriting paragraph states Tim Rice wrote A Whole New World for the production.
Intro identifies first fully animated feature in 1937; filmography lists Snow White 1937, Pinocchio/Fantasia 1940, Bambi 1942; Aladdin 1992 and other film release years.
